name: hsa-locker
description: Keep every medical receipt and EOB for your HSA in one place you host yourself on Cloudflare.

scripts.deploy: npm run build && npm run release
scripts.db:seed:sample:local: tsx scripts/export-to-sql.ts seed/sample.json .wrangler/sample.sql && wrangler d1 execute DB --local --file .wrangler/sample.sql
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.app.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.worker.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.node.json --noEmit

APP_PASSWORD.description: The one password your household uses to sign in to HSA Locker. Pick something long; you can change it later in the Cloudflare dashboard under **Workers → hsa-locker → Settings → Variables and Secrets**.

DB.description: Where your receipts’ details, people, providers and reimbursements are stored.

FILES.description: Private storage for the original receipt and EOB files (and the emails they came in). Only you can open them, through the app.

OAUTH_KV.description: Stores sign-ins for AI assistants you connect to HSA Locker over MCP.

AI.description: Workers AI reads your receipts and EOBs inside your own Cloudflare account. Nothing to set up.
